notes.title: Development Diary #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I'm glad to present you the first issue of the development diary of Relieve: Desolation.

In it, I talk about the work done in the last six months and what we'll do next.
English subtitles added.

Hope you will enjoy watching it!

https://youtu.be/u6Xr5jpkAiY
